action_summary: Replace the sole v113 double-head predictor with an equal arithmetic blend of the existing X3D and raw-EEG model families, each retaining its checkpoint architecture, checkpoint averaging, mirror augmentation and 0–20 Hz filtering. This removes the newly refactored member associated with the large regression and restores two contributors whose inclusion improved earlier scores; it is not an exact reconstruction of v111. Add prediction shape/finiteness checks and small numerical clipping followed by row normalization, preserving submission column order and Kaggle paths. Convert notebook shell copies into equivalent Python shutil calls. No training or inference was run; leaderboard improvement remains unmeasured.
